TODAY, when money moved in or out in amounts large enough that WHEN it moved would decide the percentage, the Return states nothing and the screen shows the dollar walk alone. That person — someone actively adding money — is the one who most needs a rate and currently never sees one.

Q11.his_words: Q11: Refuse the line and ask
Q11.what_was_built: When nothing says what a holding is, the app does not guess. The holding is counted in no class — it shows as Unclassified — and Net worth asks the person what it is. Their answer ends the asking and stays through every sync.

Q12.his_words: Q12: user entry stays even if it is not in the import file. If user modify cost or quantity post import/linked from institution, cost basis should not be overwritten in future sync as quantity, price and market value can change with time but not cost.
Q12.what_was_built: What a person enters on a linked account stays. A holding they added stays even when the broker's list does not carry it. A cost they set is kept by every later sync: the shares, the price and the value follow the broker, the cost per share does not.
